png_command: Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing; $conceptFiles = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath 'docs/spec/concepts/v2' -Filter '*.png' -File | Sort-Object Name); if ($conceptFiles.Count -ne 4) { throw 'Expected 4 final PNGs' }; foreach ($conceptFile in $conceptFiles) { $conceptImage = [System.Drawing.Image]::FromFile($conceptFile.FullName); try { if ($conceptImage.Width -ne 1536 -or $conceptImage.Height -ne 1024 -or $conceptImage.RawFormat.Guid -ne [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png.Guid) { throw ('Invalid image: ' + $conceptFile.Name) }; Write-Output ('{0}: {1}x{2} PNG' -f $conceptFile.Name,$conceptImage.Width,$conceptImage.Height) } finally { $conceptImage.Dispose() } }; Write-Output 'PASS: 4/4 final PNGs, 1536x1024'
